title: AION 2 Download: Steam, PURPLE and Requirements
description: Download AION 2 Global safely through Steam or PURPLE, check PC requirements and required storage, and troubleshoot installation and access errors.
summary: Use the official Global PC client, allow 100 GB of available storage, and check your account's access separately from installation. Follow the steps for your chosen launcher.
quickAnswer: Install the Global PC client from Steam’s AION 2 app 3393110 or the official PURPLE launcher. Reserve 100 GB of available storage and finish updates; installation alone does not grant Advanced Access.
